source_clock.offset_rule: UTC+3 during US daylight-saving time; UTC+2 otherwise

development_2018_2019_dst_intervals.rule: for tradable timestamps whose civil date is within US DST interval, Darwinex source clock offset=+03:00; otherwise +02:00; transition occurs during weekend market closure so no synthetic intraday transition is inserted

bar_anchor.signal_bars: anchor to Darwinex source-clock civil boundaries after source timestamp preservation is verified
bar_anchor.multi_tf: only fully closed context bars available strictly before entry

same_day_exit.definition: no position may cross the Darwinex source-clock trading-date boundary
same_day_exit.normal_day: exit at last valid executable side-specific quote before the source-clock date changes; instrument session close takes precedence if earlier
same_day_exit.friday: exit at last valid executable quote before official Friday session close
same_day_exit.missing_terminal_quote: use last valid quote before boundary; never invent EOF price

evidence.user_provenance: Darwinex source clock previously user-confirmed and bound to canonical carrier identities
